_comment: Polish search keywords for ARASAAC pictograms upstream has NOT translated. ARASAAC's Polish effort stopped in 2024 (everything created up to 2020 is 100% covered; 2025-26 is 0%), leaving 1,090 pictograms unsearchable in Polish. Keys are ARASAAC ids as strings. ARASAAC ALWAYS WINS: build-symbol-index.mjs consults these only where upstream has no keyword for that pictogram, so an entry retires itself when the real translation lands and nothing here can shadow ARASAAC data. These are SEARCH KEYWORDS, not board vocabulary - they are never spoken and never become a button label on their own (the caregiver types that), so they do not fall under the never-machine-translate rule that governs boards. They do still surface as the result label beside the picture, so they want the same native-speaker check.
_provenance: Clock faces (96) are rule-generated by gen-clock-keywords.mjs. The rest were authored from ARASAAC's own English + Spanish keywords and are PENDING NATIVE VERIFICATION - see keyword-overrides.pl.review.md for the reviewable list with both source languages and a confidence flag.
